description: Code and data of the paper 'A digital twin of a layered-bed hydrogen PSA unit: when do conformal purity guarantees survive surrogate-based optimisation?' (submitted to the International Journal of Hydrogen Energy, 2026). A dynamic model of a layered-bed (activated carbon / zeolite) H2 PSA unit built from published adsorption data (Lopes 2010) and validated against laboratory breakthrough and cycle experiments; 3357 cyclic-steady-state simulations of a pre-registered study testing whether conformal prediction bounds keep a 99.99 % H2 purity specification on optimiser-selected operating points. One command regenerates every figure and every number quoted in the paper from the included CSVs. Code: MIT. Data in data/: CC BY 4.0.
